The band's first and last lines live in the two bytes after it, which the credits and window-slide code reuse as a 16-bit camera offset instead - the STAT handler is not running then

0xcb04.name: wMenuCursorX
0xcb04.note: [8-bit] Menu cursor column; MoveMenuCursor wraps it at the column count in b

0xcb05.name: wMenuCursorY
0xcb05.note: [8-bit] Menu cursor row; MoveMenuCursor wraps it at the row count in c

0xcb06.name: wMenuCursor2X
0xcb06.note: [8-bit] Secondary menu cursor column (parallel to wMenuCursorX; second selection region of the shared menu-input handler)

0xcb07.name: wMenuCursor2Y
0xcb07.note: [8-bit] Secondary menu cursor row (parallel to wMenuCursorY)

0xcb08.name: wMenuCursorLockFlags
0xcb08.note: [8-bit] Menu cursor lock flags: bit 0 / bit 1 freeze the primary / secondary cursor's movement (set on confirm) in the shared menu-input handler

0xcb0b.name: wAnimatedTileSet
0xcb0b.note: [8-bit] Which animated-tile set the shared UpdateAnimatedTiles frame task ($39:$4342) cycles: masked with $03 and used as the index into the two pointer tables at $39:$4403 and $39:$440b. Written (values $00-$03 only) by the screen setup routines that install the task: $10:$4f92 (main menu, 0), $17:$44a6/$44f5 (court diagram, 0), $17:$6f4c (1), $1b:$73e7 (1), $1e:$7333 (1), $3b:$44b3/$496d/$4d03/$5151 (0), $3b:$7a03 (star-chart results, 1), $3e:$49f7/$4abc/$4c2b (link screens, 0), $16:$4a18/$4a30 (match result: 2 on win, 3 on lose, alongside the matching palette load).

0xcb0c.name: wAnimatedTilePeriod
0xcb0c.note: [8-bit] Frame period of the animated-tile task: $cb0a counts 0,1,..,period-1 and the animation only steps on the frame it wraps to 0 ($39:$434e-$4363). Written with $03 by almost every caller, $05 at $3e:$4ac1, $06 at $16:$4a6c.

0xcb0d.name: wMenuInputPressed
0xcb0d.note: [8-bit] Menu loop's copy of hInputPressed (same bit layout as hPlayerInputFlags)

0xcb0e.name: wMatchFormatDoubles
0xcb0e.note: [8-bit] Match-format menu: singles (0) / doubles (1) selection; copied to wMatchIsDoubles

0xcb0f.name: wMatchFormatGames
0xcb0f.note: [8-bit] Match-format menu: games-per-set selection index; table-mapped to wMatchTypeNumberOfGames

0xcb10.name: wMatchFormatSets
0xcb10.note: [8-bit] Match-format menu: number-of-sets selection index (0-2); table-mapped to wMatchTypeNumberOfSets

0xcb11.name: wMenuSlideDirection
0xcb11.note: [8-bit] Menu transition direction (1 = forward into submenu, 0 = back); direction arg to the *SlideIn/*SlideOut menu transitions

0xcb12.name: wMenuBgScrollY
0xcb12.note: [2 bytes] Y of each scrolling menu-background lane; TickMenuBgScroll decrements both and wraps $b0 back to $a0

0xcb14.name: wMenuBgScrollX
0xcb14.note: [8-bit] X shared by both lanes (passed in e to QueueSpriteTemplate)

0xcb15.name: wMenuBgScrollTile
0xcb15.note: [2 bytes] Per-lane tile argument (c) for SpriteTemplate_39_4bbf

0xcb17.name: wMenuBgScrollAttr
0xcb17.note: [2 bytes] Per-lane attribute argument (b) for SpriteTemplate_39_4bbf

0xcb19.name: wMenuBgScrollLane
0xcb19.note: [8-bit] Which lane TickMenuBgScroll queues this tick; it alternates 0/1

0xcb1a.name: wCheatCodeLength
0xcb1a.note: [8-bit] How many button presses of the cheat code have been entered. It indexes the 32-byte buffer at WRAM bank $01 $d000 (masked to $1f) that UpdateCheatCodeEntry compares against CheatCodeEntryTable, and ResetCheatCodeBuffer zeroes both

0xcb1b.name: wMainMenuCursor
0xcb1b.note: [8-bit] Cell index the main-menu cursor was last left on, so the menu reopens where you were; RunMainMenu restores it through SetMenuCursorFromCellIndex and stores it back on exit. Cleared with the other saved cursors when a new game starts

0xcb1c.name: wSavedDataMenuCursor
0xcb1c.note: [8-bit] Saved cursor cell for the saved-data source menu (RunSavedDataSourceSelect)

0xcb1d.name: wN64TransferMenuCursor
0xcb1d.note: [8-bit] Saved cursor cell for the N64 transfer item menu (RunN64TransferItemSelect)

0xcb1e.name: wSubMenuCursor
0xcb1e.note: [8-bit] Saved cursor cell shared by the N64 record-type menu and the two court-select menus in bank $3e

0xcb20.name: wSelectedMinigame
0xcb20.note: [8-bit] Minigame chosen on the minigame-select screen; RunMinigameModeFlow turns it into the config-table row (index * 3 + wMinigameLevel) and RunMinigameRulesPages picks the rules pages from it

0xcb26.name: wPauseMenuWindowId
0xcb26.note: [8-bit] Window handle owned by bank $1a's menu code. Stored from the return value of CreateMenuWindowFromText ($1a:$403c) and CreateWindow ($1a:$43c0), then passed in a to RunMenuSelectionShared ($1a:$404b), CloseWindow ($1a:$4070, $1a:$444d), WriteStringToWindow ($1a:$43df/$43f9) and GetWindowStructPtr ($1a:$4149).

0xcb27.name: wMenuInitialRow
0xcb27.note: [8-bit] Preset cursor row for the next RunMenuSelectionShared ($05:$4aa8) call: at menu open it is copied into the live row variable ($d830, WRAM bank $05) and then cleared to 0 ($05:$4ad1-$4ad8), so it defaults to row 0. Bank $1a writes the last selected row here ($1a:$41b8/$41ca/$4203/$4232) before rebuilding the pause menu so re-entry restores the cursor; $1a:$4093 clears it when the menu closes for good.

0xcb28.name: wMenuAdjustRowMask
0xcb28.note: [8-bit] Per-row mask of menu rows on which LEFT/RIGHT act as a value adjust: bit 7 = mask present, bits 0-6 = one bit per row (tested by rotating right ($d830)+1 times, $05:$4c77-$4c8e and $05:$4ca3-$4cba). Gates the LEFT/RIGHT branch of the menu driver (Func_05_4c76, called at $05:$4bd5) and makes AnimateMenuScrollArrowsTask draw the left/right arrows on that row. Set by bank $1a: $83 (rows 0-1) for the pause menu at $1a:$4249, $8c (rows 2-3) for the minigame pause menu at $1a:$4386; cleared at $1a:$4096.

0xcb29.name: wMenuKeepOpenRowMask
0xcb29.note: [8-bit] Per-row mask (same bit7-present + rotate-by-row encoding as $cb28) of menu rows that must NOT close the menu window when chosen: after RunMenuSelectionShared returns, $1a:$4057-$406e tests the bit for the chosen row and jumps past the CloseWindow call at $1a:$4070 when set. Written with the same values as $cb28 ($83 at $1a:$424e, $8c at $1a:$4389); cleared at $1a:$409c.

0xcb2a.name: wPauseMenuOptionBits
0xcb2a.note: [8-bit] Pause-menu options state: the low nibble holds the per-option toggle bits the music/sound rows flip, bit 5 gates DrawPauseMenuSettingValues, and bits 6-7 are set once a row has been visited. Cleared by ResetPauseMenuState

0xcb2d.name: wTennisDictScrollTop
0xcb2d.note: [8-bit] Study Vocabulary / Tennis Dictionary screen (bank $3f): index of the first entry shown in the 6-row scrolling term list. Absolute entry = ($cb2d + $cb2e) mod $cb2f (Func_3f_517b, $3f:$5181). Advanced/wrapped against $cb2f when the cursor runs off the top/bottom ($3f:$56d6-$56e2, $3f:$5700-$570c), recomputed by the page-jump helpers Func_3f_5192/Func_3f_520f, and used as the render start in Func_3f_5261 ($3f:$528d). Cleared on screen entry at $3f:$40c8.

0xcb2e.name: wTennisDictCursorRow
0xcb2e.note: [8-bit] Study Vocabulary screen (bank $3f): cursor row within the visible page. On the scrolling term list it is clamped to 0-5 ($3f:$56c6-$56f8) and scrolls $cb2d past those limits; on the 9-cell category index page it is clamped to 0-8 ($3f:$55b0-$55de). Drives the highlight row (stride $80 = 4 tilemap rows, Func_3f_54c8) and the hand-cursor sprite Y (stride $10 px, $3f:$4f9a-$4fab). Cleared at $3f:$40cb and reset to 0 by the page-jump helpers ($3f:$51a2, $3f:$522c, $3f:$5495).

0xcb2f.name: wTennisDictEntryCount
0xcb2f.note: [8-bit] Study Vocabulary screen (bank $3f): number of list entries that pass the current category filter. Computed by Func_3f_50f7 ($3f:$5102-$5116) by counting bytes of SelectionMaskGrid_3f_539e that AND with $cb32 (up to the $40 terminator), and used as the wrap modulus for the scroll offset ($3f:$5181, $3f:$5700, $3f:$51ac).

0xcb32.name: wTennisDictCategoryMask
0xcb32.note: [8-bit] Study Vocabulary screen (bank $3f): category filter mask. Set from the screen mode at $3f:$40be - $01/$02/$04/$08/$10 for modes 0-4, $1f (all categories) for mode 5 and any other value. Every list walk ANDs it against the per-entry category byte in SelectionMaskGrid_3f_539e to decide whether an entry is listed ($3f:$5102, $3f:$5295, $3f:$5339, $3f:$5422, $3f:$547c, $3f:$51a5, $3f:$522f, $3f:$5625).

0xcb33.name: wTennisDictSingleEntry
0xcb33.note: [8-bit] Set to 1 in the two Study Vocabulary modes ($05 and $06) that show one fixed entry rather than the scrolling list, which is what makes the description path skip GetTennisDictionarySelectedIndex

0xcb34.name: wTennisDictMode
0xcb34.note: [8-bit] Study Vocabulary screen (bank $3f): the mode argument passed in a to TennisDictionaryScreen, stored at $3f:$4082. Modes 0-5 pick the category mask in $cb32 and open the term list directly; mode 6 (the only value used in the retail flow, $10:$54b8) opens the 9-cell category index page instead - checked at $3f:$40f0, $3f:$412a, $3f:$4ed4 (index-page sprite animation) and $3f:$56ab (B-button return code $10 vs $01).

0xcb37.name: wTennisDictFlags
0xcb37.note: [8-bit] Study Vocabulary screen (bank $3f) display flags, cleared at $3f:$40c5. bit 0 = a description window is open: set at $3f:$5620 before CreateDialogueWindow, cleared at $3f:$5699/$413a, and freezes the hand-cursor animation counter $cb3e ($3f:$4f8c). bit 1 = the scrolling term list is on screen (set $3f:$414d/$41d0, cleared $3f:$421a for the index page); gates drawing of the cursor sprites ($3f:$4f85) and shifts the index-page sprites by $10 px ($3f:$4f1f/$4f3a/$4f55/$4f70). bit 2 / bit 3 = flash the left / right page arrow this frame - set on LEFT ($3f:$571b) and RIGHT ($3f:$5731), drawn from SpriteTemplate_3f_5006 at X $18 / $88 ($3f:$4fc9/$4fdc), and both cleared at the top of every input tick ($3f:$560a).

0xcb38.name: wTennisDictAnimState
0xcb38.note: [8-bit] Animation state of the tennis-dictionary mascot: 3 and 4 alternate on a wTennisDictAnimTimer expiry, and StartTennisDictionaryAnim restarts it from the VBlank counter's low bits so the pose varies

0xcb39.name: wTennisDictSpriteTimer
0xcb39.note: [8-bit] Eight-frame divider for the Study Vocabulary demo sprite: UpdateTennisDictionarySprites counts it down, reloads $08 and steps wTennisDictSpritePhase each time it reaches zero

0xcb3a.name: wTennisDictSpritePhase
0xcb3a.note: [8-bit] Phase 0-15 of the Study Vocabulary demo sprite animation, wrapped at $10

0xcb3d.name: wTennisDictAnimTimer
0xcb3d.note: [8-bit] Frames left in the current wTennisDictAnimState; $b4 on a restart and $ff for the long idle

0xcb3f.name: wCutsceneStep
0xcb3f.note: [8-bit] Bank $6b cutscene driver (intro/title/award ceremony): current step index, dispatched through the per-scene jumptable

0xcb40.name: wCutsceneStepTimer
0xcb40.note: [8-bit] Bank $6b cutscene driver: frame counter for the current step; incremented per frame and compared against per-step thresholds to advance wCutsceneStep

0xcb41.name: wIntroCutsceneCheck
0xcb41.note: [8-bit] Intro Cutscene Check (0x00 when in intro cutscene, 0x01 otherwise)

0xcb42.name: wCutsceneScrollX
0xcb42.note: [8-bit] Bank $6b cutscene driver: accumulated horizontal pan position, copied to hScrollX each frame

0xcb43.name: wIntroCutsceneSubState
0xcb43.note: [8-bit] Sub-state within the intro cutscene's current state; the State*Init routines seed it and the matching State*Update routines step it

0xcb44.name: wCutsceneSpriteAX
0xcb44.note: [8-bit] X of the intro cutscene's first sprite group; the state Update routines walk it and QueueCutsceneSpriteGroupA adds each template's offset to it

0xcb45.name: wCutsceneSpriteAY
0xcb45.note: [8-bit] Y of the intro cutscene's first sprite group

0xcb46.name: wCutsceneSpriteBX
0xcb46.note: [8-bit] X of the intro cutscene's second sprite group (QueueCutsceneSpriteGroupB)

0xcb47.name: wCutsceneSpriteBY
0xcb47.note: [8-bit] Y of the intro cutscene's second sprite group

0xcb4a.name: wIntroCutsceneScrollY
0xcb4a.note: [16-bit] Intro cutscene (bank $6b): world-space vertical scroll/camera position, little-endian. Initialised to $0120 at the start of scenes 00/12/19 ($6b:$41bf, $6b:$4916, $6b:$4c65) and decremented every frame by the per-frame delta table at $6b:$4cc1 indexed by wCutsceneStepTimer ($6b:$4caa-$4cbd). Consumers: ApplyCutsceneScrollToSpriteX ($6b:$5191) subtracts it from the sprite base coordinate that QueueSpriteTemplate treats as Y (the sp+0 slot, $00:$1ebf - so despite the existing label it is the Y axis), and SetCameraYFromScrollPos ($6b:$60d5) shifts it left 5 into wCameraY. $6b:$60fe uses ($cb48 - $cb4a) as the on-screen Y of the object drawn by QueueIntroSpriteBlock.

0xcb4c.name: wCutsceneSpriteAnimFrame
0xcb4c.note: [8-bit] Animation frame the intro cutscene's scrolling sprites are drawn on, derived from wCutsceneSpriteAnimTick's bits 4-5 shifted down, so it steps once every 16 ticks

0xcb4d.name: wCutsceneSpriteAnimTick
0xcb4d.note: [8-bit] Free-running counter AdvanceSpriteAnimTimer increments each call; the intro cutscene state inits clear it together with wCutsceneSpriteAnimFrame

0xcb4f.name: wCharSelectIdleAnimState
0xcb4f.note: [8-bit] Idle-animation state of the character-select portrait, cleared everywhere wCharSelectIdleTimer and wCharSelectHandedness are (screen setup, page reload, and after a fresh animation is set) and stepped by TickCharSelectIdleAnim when the timer expires

0xcb50.name: wCharSelectHandedness
0xcb50.note: [8-bit] Story-mode character-select screen (bank $38): handedness toggle, 0 = default, 1 = mirrored (left-handed). Cleared on entry ($38:$4815, $38:$4984, $38:$4a82) and flipped by START ($38:$48fc `xor $01`) - the on-screen prompt for that row is text 30:118 'START: Change Hands' ($38:$4b0c). When non-zero, Func_38_4bac sets bit 5 (OAM X-flip) in wCharSpriteSlot+1 for all four displayed characters ($38:$4c6f-$4ca6), and Func_38_4e23 draws the marker sprite with tile base $00 instead of $02 ($38:$4e3c). The chosen value is written into the story character record at +$0e ($38:$48ba).

0xcb51.name: wCharSelectIdleTimer
0xcb51.note: [8-bit] Frames until the character-select portrait plays its idle animation: TickCharSelectIdleAnim counts to $0f, then switches the shown character from animation 5 to 7 and starts again

0xcb52.name: wCharSelectIsPartner
0xcb52.note: [8-bit] Story-mode character-select screen (bank $38): which pick is in progress - 0 = main character, 1 = partner. Stored from the b argument of RunCharacterSelectScreen ($38:$47d0; callers pass 0 at $10:$40bb and $1b:$61fa, 1 at $1b:$629b). Selects the prompt text (0 -> text 30:117 'Pick a Character' at $38:$4ae8, 1 -> text 30:119 'Choose Partner' at $38:$4afb), swaps in mugshots 2/3 and repositions the two character sprites ($38:$4a27, $38:$4c13), and is doubled into the character id: id = 2*$cb52 + cursor ($38:$4896, $38:$4958, $38:$4e09).

0xcb53.name: wLinkPartnerCourtMask
0xcb53.note: [8-bit] Court-select: the link partner's bonus-court unlock mask, received over the cable. Cleared at $10:$5171 for local play; set at $38:$75ef/$75f7 from the received link block ($ca8a or $ca0a depending on hLinkState) right after the block-$26 exchange that sends our own $cb54 ($38:$759c). ORed with $cb54 before StoreCourtUnlockBits ($3e:$5d18, $3e:$65db) and before choosing the 9-court vs 4-court menu ($38:$748d).

0xcb54.name: wUnlockedCourtMask
0xcb54.note: [8-bit] Bitmask of the five unlockable bonus courts (court ids 4-8; courts 0-3 are always available per IsCourtUnlocked $3e:$697b). Built from the save flags by ComputeUnlockedCourtFlags ($3e:$69a0-$69c9, one bit per row of the 5-entry table at $3e:$69ca) and cleared at $10:$5174. Passed in b to StoreCourtUnlockBits ($3e:$695a), which explodes it into the five per-court bytes at $d000 in WRAM bank $02; also decides whether the 9-court or the 4-court select menu runs ($10:$5199, $38:$7489) and is the payload of link block $26 ($38:$759c).

0xcb60.name: wCutsceneSlideTimer
0xcb60.note: [8-bit] Frame counter of bank $03's scrolling story cutscene. AnimateWindowSlideUpTask increments it and drives rWY from $90 minus its low 6 bits, sliding the window up; UpdateSceneAnimation takes its low 2 bits as the gate that steps the cutscene's animation frame

0xcb61.name: wBgMapShadowDirty
0xcb61.note: Dirty flags for the bank $18 BG map shadow buffers: low nibble set -> queue $d800->$9800 tilemap copy, high nibble -> $dc00->VRAM1 $9800 attrmap copy (FlushBgMapShadowToVram clears it).

0xcb62.name: wDebugCharViewerPage
0xcb62.note: [8-bit] Debug character viewer (Func_1a_67d4, reachable only from the unused debug path at $01:$41bf/$41fd with hDebugStepMode set): page of the 2x16 character grid, 0 or 1. Cleared at $1a:$67d5, incremented/decremented when the cursor wraps off the bottom/top row ($1a:$695f, $1a:$698f), and combined into the selected character id as ($cb62 << 4) + $cb63 -> $d002 ($1a:$69d0-$69dc), which is then fed to LoadOnCourtCharTilesA ($1a:$6837).

0xcb63.name: wDebugCharViewerIndex
0xcb63.note: [8-bit] Debug character viewer (Func_1a_67d4): cursor index 0-15 within the current page - LEFT/RIGHT step by 1 and wrap inside the current row of 8 ($1a:$691b-$692d, $1a:$6934-$6945), UP/DOWN step by 8 and roll into $cb62 ($1a:$694c, $1a:$6979). Selected character id = ($cb62 << 4) + $cb63 ($1a:$69d8). Also indexes the cursor-sprite position table at $1a:$6b0f ($1a:$6af9).

0xcb6b.name: wDigitSpriteTileBase
0xcb6b.note: [8-bit] First tile of the loaded digit sprite set; DrawDigitSprite_39 forms the tile as digit * 2 + this, so the narrow and wide digit sets can share one drawer

0xcb6c.name: wDigitSpriteAttr
0xcb6c.note: [8-bit] OAM attribute DrawDigitSprite_39 queues digits with

0xcb6d.name: wStorySceneAssetIndex
0xcb6d.note: [8-bit] Scene selector RunStorySceneByMode stores from c ($18:$7617); each LookupScreen<N>AssetId indexes its Screen<N>AssetIdTable with it to pick the screen's asset record

0xcb6e.name: wRulesPageTextIdBase
0xcb6e.note: [16-bit] Rules/briefing screens: base text id of the minigame's rules pages, taken from MinigameRulesTextIdBases_17 ($17:$6fdb) at $17:$6fc6. Each page offset from the minigame's MinigameRulesPageLists_17 row is added to it ($17:$70ef) and the result rendered through PrepareGlyphBuffer / RenderProportionalTextAt.

0xcb71.name: wCheatUnlockTriggered
0xcb71.note: [8-bit] Set to 1 once the cheat code has been matched and TriggerCheatUnlock has run, which stops UpdateCheatCodeEntry accepting any more input. The title and main-menu loops clear it when they re-enter

0xcb75.name: wTextRowNextTile
0xcb75.note: [8-bit] Next window tile id the text engine will stamp into the shadow tilemap. A row starts at wGlyphRowStartCol + $80 and the cell loop increments it per cell before writing it back, so a wrapped row carries on where the previous one stopped

0xcb76.name: wGlyphTileWritePtr
0xcb76.note: VRAM tile-data write pointer for the proportional-glyph renderer (bank $05 text engine)

0xcb78.name: wGlyphStampEnabled
0xcb78.note: [8-bit] Nonzero when the text being rendered belongs to a window other than wMenuWindowId, which is the condition StampGlyphTileAtPen requires before it writes a glyph tile through wGlyphTileWritePtr. Menu text goes through the tilemap alone

0xcc00.name: wDebugTextBuffer
0xcc00.note: [576 bytes] Debug text console tilemap buffer, DMAed to $9d00 rows when active

0xff80.name: hOAMDMARoutine
0xff80.note: [10 bytes] OAM DMA trampoline, copied here from ROM0 $06ba by CopyOAMDMARoutineToHRAM: ld a, $c0 / ldh [rDMA], a / 40-iteration wait / ret. Must live in HRAM because the bus is unusable during the transfer

0xff8d.name: hVBlankOccurred
0xff8d.note: [8-bit] Set at end of VBlank handler; AdvanceFrame waits on it

0xff8f.name: hFrameTasksReady
0xff8f.note: [8-bit] Nonzero when wFrameTasks is consistent; cleared while the list is mutated so the frame hook skips it

0xff90.name: hPlayerInputFlags
0xff90.note:
[8-bit] Player Input Flags

Bit 7 - Down
Bit 6 - Up
Bit 5 - Left
Bit 4 - Right
Bit 3 - Start
Bit 2 - Select
Bit 1 - B
Bit 0 - A

0xff91.name: hInputPressed
0xff91.note: [8-bit] Buttons newly pressed this frame (same bit layout as hPlayerInputFlags)

0xff94.name: hInputRisingEdge
0xff94.note: [8-bit] Buttons newly pressed this frame (raw, before repeat processing)

0xff95.name: hRomBank
0xff95.note: [8-bit] Shadow of the current ROM bank (written together with the MBC register at $2000)

0xff96.name: hWramBank
0xff96.note: [8-bit] Shadow of the current WRAM bank (last value written to rSVBK); match engine swaps banks 4-7 for per-character data

0xff97.name: hSramBank
0xff97.note: [8-bit] Shadow of the current SRAM bank (always written together with the MBC RAM-bank register at $4000)

0xff98.name: hShowDebugConsole
0xff98.note: [8-bit] 1 = VBlank switches BG map to the debug console view

0xff99.name: hVRAMQueueDirty
0xff99.note: [8-bit] Nonzero = VRAM copy / tile-write queues have pending entries

0xff9a.name: hDebugStepPaused
0xff9a.note: [8-bit] Nonzero while the debug stepper is holding the frame. AdvanceFrame sets it when SELECT+START are held (only once hDebugStepMode has enabled stepping at all) and spins in its step loop until START clears it; SELECT while paused cycles hDebugStepMode 1-3 rather than resuming

0xff9b.name: hSpriteQueueIndex
0xff9b.note: [8-bit] Write offset into the OAM shadow buffer (max $a0)

0xff9c.name: hSpriteQueueBase
0xff9c.note: [8-bit] OAM shadow offset where per-frame sprites start (entries below persist)

0xff9d.name: hPaletteDirtyFlags
0xff9d.note: [8-bit] Bit 0 = BG palettes dirty, bit 1 = OBJ palettes dirty

0xff9f.name: hSavedIE
0xff9f.note: [8-bit] rIE saved across DisableLCDSafely's VBlank wait: it masks the VBlank interrupt off, spins until rLY hits $91, turns the LCD off and restores rIE from here

0xffa0.name: hPeakLY
0xffa0.note: [8-bit] Peak LY at end-of-frame (frame time meter shown on debug console)

0xffa2.name: hFadeState
0xffa2.note: [8-bit] Bit 0 = fading out, bit 1 = fading in, bit 7 = fade to white

0xffa7.name: hMathSign
0xffa7.note: [8-bit] Sign scratch for signed multiply/divide wrappers

0xffac.name: hDivDividendHi
0xffac.note: [8-bit] DivAHLByDE: high byte of the 24-bit dividend (a of a:hl), saved on entry to the wide-divisor path

0xffad.name: hDivQuotientMid
0xffad.note: [8-bit] DivAHLByDE: middle byte of the quotient, collected as the unrolled loop passes bit 7; the tail returns it in h

0xffae.name: hDivQuotientHi
0xffae.note: [8-bit] DivAHLByDE: high byte of the quotient, collected at bit 15; the tail returns it in a, so the result comes back as a:hl like the dividend went in

0xffb8.name: hBGRowBlitPending
0xffb8.note: [8-bit] Nonzero = row in wBGRowBlitBuffer awaits VBlank blit

0xffb9.name: hBGColumnBlitPending
0xffb9.note: [8-bit] Nonzero = column in wBGColumnBlitBuffer awaits VBlank blit

0xffba.name: hBGColumnBlitDone
0xffba.note: [8-bit] Set when the slow column blit ran this VBlank (skips VRAM queue)

0xffc0.name: hLinkRxByte
0xffc0.note: [8-bit] Last byte received over the serial link (captured from rSB in the serial interrupt)

0xffc1.name: hLinkTxByte
0xffc1.note: [8-bit] Next byte to transmit over the serial link (copied to rSB)

0xffc2.name: hLinkState
0xffc2.note: [8-bit] Serial link state/role (0 = idle, 1/2 = connected roles); gates the encode/decode paths

0xffc3.name: hLinkErrorFlags
0xffc3.note: [8-bit] Link error flags beside hLinkState. AdvanceFrame tests the top three bits while hLinkCounter is nonzero and jumps to LinkErrorReset if any is set -- but nothing in the ROM ever sets them, so the check never fires; InitSerialLink and ResetSerialState only clear it

0xffc4.name: hUnusedLinkByte
0xffc4.note: [8-bit] Cleared by InitSerialLink and ResetSerialState and read by nothing else

0xffc6.name: hLinkNibbleAccum
0xffc6.note: [8-bit] Nibble-block transfer: the received nibble pair being assembled into a byte by ExchangeNibbleBlockMaster/Slave

0xffc7.name: hLinkBlockOffset
0xffc7.note: [8-bit] Nibble-block transfer: byte offset into the $ce40 block buffer, stepped once per byte exchanged

0xffc8.name: hLinkCounter
0xffc8.note: [8-bit] Serial link exchange/frame counter; increments per exchange and caps at 8

0xffcd.name: hActiveJingle
0xffcd.note: [8-bit] Jingle sound id currently overriding BGM (0 = none)

0xfffe.name: hIsCGB
0xfffe.note: [8-bit] 1 = running on Game Boy Color hardware
